# Pixel Runner

A side‑scrolling HTML‑canvas game where the player controls a small square that automatically runs forward. Randomly generated obstacles (spikes, moving bars) appear; the player can jump or slide with the arrow keys. Colliding with an obstacle or falling off the platform triggers a game‑over lose condition.

1: // Improved graphics side‑scroll runner
2: // Added sky gradient, ground line, rounded player, obstacle visuals
3: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = 800; canvas.height = 200;
6: // audio context for sound effects
7: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8: function playSound(freq, duration) {
9:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:   osc.frequency.value = freq;
12:   osc.type = 'sine';
13:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
14:   osc.connect(gain);
15:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:   osc.start();
17:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
18: }
19: // specific sound helpers
20: function playJumpSound() { playSound(440, 0.1); }
21: function playSlideSound() { playSound(200, 0.08); }
22: function playHitSound() { playSound(100, 0.3); }
23: 
24: // player
25: const player = {
26:   w: 20,
27:   h: 20,
28:   x: 50,
29:   y: canvas.height - 40,
30:   vy: 0,
31:   onGround: true,
32:   slide: false,
33: };
34: 
35: const GRAVITY = 0.6;
36: const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
37: const SLIDE_TIME = 15;
38: let slideTimer = 0;
39: 
40: // obstacles
41: const obstacles = [];
42: // decorative clouds for parallax background
43: const clouds = [];
44: const CLOUD_FREQ = 300; // frames
45: const CLOUD_SPEED = 1;
46: const OBSTACLE_FREQ = 120; // frames
47: let frameCount = 0;
48: 
49: function spawnObstacle() {
50:   const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'spike' : 'bar';
51:   if (type === 'spike') {
52:     obstacles.push({x: canvas.width, y: canvas.height - 30, w: 20, h: 20, type});
53:   } else {
54:     const h = 40 + Math.random() * 40;
55:     obstacles.push({x: canvas.width, y: canvas.height - h, w: 20, h, type});
56:   }
57: }
58: 
59: // spawn simple fluffy cloud for background
60: function spawnCloud() {
61:   const w = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
62:   const h = w * 0.6;
63:   const y = 20 + Math.random() * (canvas.height / 2 - 40);
64:   clouds.push({x: canvas.width, y, w, h});
65: }
66: 
67: function update() {
68:   frameCount++;
69:   if (frameCount % OBSTACLE_FREQ === 0) spawnObstacle();
70:   if (frameCount % CLOUD_FREQ === 0) spawnCloud();
71: 
72:   // player physics
73:   if (!player.onGround) player.vy += GRAVITY;
74:   player.y += player.vy;
75:   if (player.y >= canvas.height - 40) {
76:     player.y = canvas.height - 40;
77:     player.vy = 0;
78:     player.onGround = true;
79:   }
80:   // slide timer
81:   if (slideTimer > 0) {
82:     slideTimer--;
83:     if (slideTimer === 0) player.slide = false;
84:   }
85: 
86:   // move obstacles left
87:   for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
88:     const o = obstacles[i];
89:     o.x -= 4;
90:     // collision
91:     if (o.x < player.x + player.w && o.x + o.w > player.x &&
92:         o.y < player.y + player.h && o.y + o.h > player.y) {
93:       gameOver();
94:       return;
95:     }
96:     // remove off‑screen
97:     if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
98:   }
99: 
100:   // move clouds left (parallax)
101:   for (let i = clouds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
102:     const c = clouds[i];
103:     c.x -= CLOUD_SPEED;
104:     if (c.x + c.w < 0) clouds.splice(i, 1);
105:   }
106: }
107: 
108: function draw() {
109:   // sky background gradient
110:   const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
111:   skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB');
112:   skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#fff');
113:   ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
114:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
115: 
116:   // ground
117:   ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
118:   ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - 20, canvas.width, 20);
119:   // ground line
120:   ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
121:   ctx.beginPath();
122:   ctx.moveTo(0, canvas.height - 20);
123:   ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height - 20);
124:   ctx.stroke();
125: 
126:   // player (rounded rectangle with shadow)
127:   const ph = player.slide ? player.h / 2 : player.h;
128:   const py = player.slide ? player.y + player.h / 2 : player.y;
129:   const radius = 5;
130:   ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
131:   ctx.beginPath();
132:   ctx.moveTo(player.x + radius, py);
133:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w - radius, py);
134:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, py, player.x + player.w, py + radius);
135:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, py + ph - radius);
136:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, py + ph, player.x + player.w - radius, py + ph);
137:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + radius, py + ph);
138:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, py + ph, player.x, py + ph - radius);
139:   ctx.lineTo(player.x, py + radius);
140:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, py, player.x + radius, py);
141:   ctx.fill();
142: 
143:   // clouds (parallax background)
144:   ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
145:   clouds.forEach(c => {
146:     ctx.beginPath();
147:     ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w / 2, c.y + c.h / 2, c.w / 2, c.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
148:     ctx.fill();
149:   });
150: 
151:   // obstacles
152:   obstacles.forEach(o => {
153:     if (o.type === 'spike') {
154:       // draw triangle spike
155:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600';
156:       ctx.beginPath();
157:       ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y + o.h);
158:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y);
159:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h);
160:       ctx.closePath();
161:       ctx.fill();
162:     } else {
163:       // bar obstacle
164:       ctx.fillStyle = '#aa0000';
165:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
166:     }
167:   });
168: 
169:   // player (rounded rectangle with shadow)
170:   const ph = player.slide ? player.h / 2 : player.h;
171:   const py = player.slide ? player.y + player.h / 2 : player.y;
172:   const radius = 5;
173:   ctx.save();
174:   ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
175:   ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
176:   ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
177:   ctx.beginPath();
178:   ctx.moveTo(player.x + radius, py);
179:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w - radius, py);
180:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, py, player.x + player.w, py + radius);
181:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, py + ph - radius);
182:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, py + ph, player.x + player.w - radius, py + ph);
183:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + radius, py + ph);
184:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, py + ph, player.x, py + ph - radius);
185:   ctx.lineTo(player.x, py + radius);
186:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, py, player.x + radius, py);
187:   ctx.fill();
188:   ctx.restore();
189: 
190: 
191: let running = true;
192: function gameOver() {
193:   running = false;
194:   playHitSound();
195:   ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
196:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
197:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
198:   ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
199:   ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width/2-80, canvas.height/2);
200: }
201: 
202: function loop() {
203:   if (!running) return;
204:   update();
205:   draw();
206:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
207: }
208: 
209: // controls
210: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
211:   if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' && player.onGround && !player.slide) {
212:     player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
213:     player.onGround = false;
214:     playJumpSound();
215:   }
216:   if (e.code === 'ArrowDown' && player.onGround && !player.slide) {
217:     player.slide = true;
218:     slideTimer = SLIDE_TIME;
219:     playSlideSound();
220:   }
221: });
222: 
223: loop();

(End of file - total 223 lines)
</content>
